career_path_block.路径: Paving, Surfacing, And Tamping Equipment Operators

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but knowing only manual packing and not machines. As machines spread, packers who operate equipment and cover multiple roles become more secure, while purely manual roles narrow.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but automated packaging machines + peak-season employment fluctuations. Packaging machines and robotic arms are spreading each year, reducing purely manual jobs. Packers who operate equipment, understand scanning systems, and coordinate multiple roles are more resilient. Peak-season piece-rate earnings are high but unstable.
risks: Automated packaging machines spread, reducing purely manual roles
High peak-season piece rates, with declining off-season income
Prolonged standing and high physical demands
Highly flexible staffing and weak stability
Limited skills and advancement opportunities

page.contract_project_risk_block: Packaging machines get faster every year, but when orders or specifications change, human hands still step in. Warehousing and logistics is an efficiency-driven industry: machine work is becoming more standardized, while human work is becoming more nonstandard.

responsibilities: Bag and box according to orders

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会手包不会用机器」——机器越普及，会操作设备、能顶多工种的包装工越稳，纯手工岗在收窄。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化包装机 + 旺季用工波动」——包装机与机械臂逐年普及，纯手工包装岗被压缩；会操作设备、懂扫码系统、能协调多工种的包装工更稳，旺季计件收入高但稳定性差。
risks: 自动包装机普及，纯手工岗压缩
旺季计件高，淡季收入下滑
站立作业久，体力消耗大
用工弹性大，稳定性差
技能单一，晋升空间有限

page.contract_project_risk_block: 包装机一年比一年快，但订单一变、规格一换，那双手还得临时顶上去——仓储物流是「效率」的行业，机器的活越来越标准，人的活越来越非标。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but platforms + automated inspection. Routine monitoring is taken over, while people who design systems and understand risk become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI replacement, but in-line inspection + quality platforms sharing routine monitoring. People are still needed for system design, risk assessment, and cross-functional corrective action, and must continually learn new standards.
risks: Quality platforms absorb routine monitoring
In-line inspection substitution
Must continually learn new standards
Difficult cross-functional influence
Produces reports without corrective action

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, managers still must decide which risks to address first, how to change the system, and how to respond to customers, using their minds to plan, voices to drive action, and hands to implement. People cannot be fully removed from quality management.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台 + 自动检测」——常规监控被接手，会设计懂风险的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不是被 AI 取代，而是「在线检测 + 质量平台」分担常规监控；但体系设计、风险研判与跨部门的纠偏仍要人，且需持续学新标准。
risks: 质量平台吃常规监控
在线检测替代
需持续学新标准
跨部门推动难
只出报表不纠偏

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪类风险先攻、体系怎么改、客户怎么交代，最后还是经理的脑去想、嘴去推、手去落——质量这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Replaced by self-service terminals and AI

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for information clerks is replacement by self-service and AI. Standardized reception and queries are disappearing, making combined administration and customer service the role's path forward.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is automation replacement. Self-service visitor systems, AI customer service, and online appointments substantially reduce pure front-desk functions and shrink single-role reception. The role is also easily replaced and has a low pay ceiling. Without moving into administrative operations and customer service, opportunities remain limited.
risks: Automation replacement: self-service terminals and AI customer service squeeze roles
Low pay ceiling: reception itself offers limited income
High replaceability: short training periods and abundant labor supply
Career burnout: repetitive reception and emotional strain
Limited advancement: narrow path for reception alone

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI customer service can answer ninety percent of questions, but people at the front desk still provide the professionalism machines cannot replace when handling visitor emotions, escalating complaints, and resolving incidents.

responsibilities: Provide administrative support and handle incidents

career_path_block.说明: 自助终端与 AI 替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 信息文员最大的风险是「被自助与 AI 替代」——标准化接待和查询在消失，往行政复合、客户服务方向走，才是这个岗位的出路。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化替代」——自助访客系统、AI 客服、在线预约让纯前台职能大量减少，单一前台岗位在收缩；同时岗位本身替代性强、薪资天花板低，不往行政运营和客户服务方向走，空间有限。
risks: 自动化替代：自助终端与 AI 客服挤压岗位
薪资天花板低：前台本身收入有限
替代性强：培养周期短、供给充足
职业倦怠：重复接待与情绪消耗
晋升受限：单一前台路径窄

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 客服能回答九成问题，但「访客的情绪、投诉的升级、突发的兜底」——站在前台接住人的那份体面，是机器替不了的服务功底。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself but 3D tools + template-based production. Systems absorb standard drawings, while people with narrative ability are better positioned.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk comes from tool-driven production. 3D tools and real-time rendering accelerate proposals, while demand for template-based exhibits shrinks. Narrative and on-site coordination still require people.
risks: 3D tools absorb standardized roles
Replaced by templates
Rendering is accelerated
Drawing production is automated
Easy to apply templates

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, designers still use judgment, drawing, and fieldwork to decide which parts of the narrative matter, how visitors should move, and how to implement the design on-site. People cannot be removed entirely from the experience.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 本身，而是「3D + 模板化」——标准出图被系统吃，有叙事力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险来自工具化——3D 与实时渲染把方案提速，模板化展陈需求在缩；但叙事与现场协调仍要人。
risks: 3D 吃标准岗
模板化替代
渲染被提速
出图被自动
易套模板

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪段叙事要紧、怎么走线、现场怎么落地，最后还是设计师的脑去想、手去画、脚去跑——体验这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself, but assistive diagnostic systems. Imaging reports will be taken over, while physicians who operate and communicate well will become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI itself, but assistive diagnostic systems. AI accelerates image recognition and rehabilitation planning, but examinations, surgery, and physician-patient trust still require people.
risks: Imaging replaced by AI
Automated reporting
Generated rehabilitation plans
Automated medical record organization
Online triage for initial consultations

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, physicians still decide whether an injured athlete should compete today, how to perform each operation, and how to build trust. Their minds decide, their hands operate, and their voices communicate. People cannot be fully removed from clinics or competition venues.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是辅助诊断系统——读片报告被接管，会手术能沟通的医师反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是辅助诊断系统——影像识别和康复规划被 AI 加速，但查体、手术与医患信任仍要人。
risks: 影像被 AI 替
报告自动化
康复规划生成

线上初诊分流

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪个伤员今天该不该上场、哪台手术怎么做、信任怎么建立，最后还是医师的脑去想、手去做、嘴去说——诊室和赛场这头，人撤不干净。
